Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.account

Class ResetPasswordUseCase

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.account.ResetPasswordUseCase
@Service public class ResetPasswordUseCase extends Object
Use case that chooses a new password with the single-use token received by e-mail. Every check (token, account, password policy including the username rule, compromised-password check) runs before the token is consumed, so a rejected password never burns the token; consuming it, storing the new hash and revoking every token of the user then happen in one transaction.

  • Method Details

    • execute

      @Transactional public void execute(String token, String newPassword)
      Resets the password of the user the token was issued to. The token is looked up without being consumed, every check runs, and only then is the token consumed; the consumption is atomic, so of two concurrent resets with the same token only one succeeds.
      Parameters:
      token - the reset token received by e-mail.
      newPassword - the clear-text new password.
      Throws:
      InvalidPasswordException - if the password breaks the policy.
      CompromisedPasswordException - if the password is known to be compromised.
      InvalidAccountTokenException - if the token is unknown, expired, used or its account is gone.
